lines: 大昌京都，皇宫内院。
夜深无月，清风微凉。
宫里此时已人迹寥寥，除了稀疏的侍卫在强打精神，看不到其他人影。
后宫药膳房，更是一片漆黑，让这座本就不起眼的院落，仿佛与黑夜融为一体。
「吱扭吱悠——」
木板被挤压的声音。
「吱扭吱悠——」
声音越来越快，仿佛一块木板承载了不该承受的重量。
“公公……你……你轻点……”
一声微弱的娇喘，突然从房内飘出。
羞涩中带着紧张，疲惫中带着谨慎。
虚虚荡荡飘散在院中，惊的池里灵龟缩回头。
话刚说完，吱悠声就低许多，变的缓慢轻柔。
一滴汗水无声滴落。
身材修长的青年男子停下动作，擦去额头汗水，咬着牙轻声回应。
其实他身上早已湿透，擦与不擦没什么区别，肆意散发出年轻气味。
对面的小红看在眼里，心中满是关切，想帮他擦一下，又腾不出手来……
她比吴谦强不了多少，香汗早就顺着身体滑下，浸湿桌面。
“都怪我笨手笨脚，碰坏桌子又修不好，大半夜还要劳烦你帮忙。”
“姑娘客气了，我净身动不了这些天，全靠小红姐照顾，这点忙不算什么。”
吴谦说着，两手一点没闲着，不断的敲敲打打。
其实吴谦也不懂木匠，只是仗着蛮力，把歪桌腿强行掰直。
吴谦身上这身臭汗，不只是累，更多是疼。
毕竟……刚净身半个月不到，说不疼那是没净过。
吴谦此时又疼又累，清秀的俊脸早已咬牙切齿，强撑着不让小红失望。
错位桌腿终于动了一下。
声音过于清脆，一时分不清是好了还是断了，吴谦赶紧钻桌子底下检查。
小红双手抬着桌角，焦急的问，“怎么样？好了吗？”
“不负所托，已完好如初了！”
吴谦咧开嘴，满意的笑言道。
小红这才敢松开双手，弯下腰细细摩挲。
确认无误后，心中石头落地，长吁一口气，
“吓死奴家了，若修不好，明天范公公肯定不饶我！”
一张破桌子值不了几个钱，皇宫大院也不差这点烂木头，问题出在药膳房新来个副总管——范岱范公公。
此人来自药膳房上级尚膳监，新官上任，没事都能挑出刺来，更别说真的犯错。
前几天另一个宫女小翠，只因洒半杯水，便被范公公拉到太阳下管教。
美名其曰法纪严明，一滴水一个耳光，最后一连打好几个嘴巴。
小翠的脸至今都没消肿，成了药膳房唯二的伤员。
content_en:
Dachang Kyoto, the inner courtyard of the imperial palace.
The night is dark and moonless, and the breeze is slightly cool.
There were only a few people in the palace at this time. Except for the sparse guards who were fighting hard, no other people could be seen.
The harem medicinal dining room was even more dark, making this already inconspicuous courtyard seem to blend into the night.
"Zhiwu Zhiyu——"
The sound of planks being squeezed.
"Zhiwu Zhiyu——"
The sound became faster and faster, as if a piece of wood was carrying a weight it shouldn't bear.
"Father...you...please be gentle..."
A weak gasp suddenly floated out from the room.
Shy yet nervous, tired yet cautious.
Xuxu was floating in the courtyard, and the turtle in the pond shrank back in surprise.
As soon as he finished speaking, his voice became much lower and became slower and gentler.
"Well..."
A drop of sweat fell silently.
The slender young man stopped, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and responded softly through gritted teeth.
In fact, his body was already soaked, and it made no difference whether he wiped it or not, exuding a youthful smell.
Xiao Hong, who was opposite, saw this in her eyes, and her heart was full of concern. She wanted to help him wipe it, but she couldn't spare her hands...
She was not much better than Wu Qian, and the fragrant sweat had already slid down her body and soaked the table.
"It's all because of my clumsiness. I broke the table and couldn't fix it. I had to bother you for help in the middle of the night."
"Girl, you're welcome. I can't move around these days, so I have to rely on Sister Xiaohong to take care of me. This small amount of work is nothing."
As Wu Qian spoke, his hands were not idle at all, and he kept tapping.
In fact, Wu Qian didn't know much about carpentry, so he just used brute force to straighten the crooked table legs.
The stinky sweat on Wu Qian's body was not only tired, but also painful.
After all...it's been less than half a month since I've been purified. If you say it doesn't hurt, it means you haven't been purified.
Wu Qian was in pain and tired at this time, and his delicate and handsome face had already gritted his teeth, trying hard not to let Xiao Hong down.
"Crack——"
The misaligned table legs finally moved.
The sound was too crisp, and it was unclear whether it was healed or broken. Wu Qian quickly got under the table to check.
Xiaohong raised the edge of the table with both hands and asked anxiously, "How is it? Are you okay?"
"It has lived up to its trust and is as good as ever!"
Wu Qian grinned and said with a satisfied smile.
Only then did Xiaohong dare to let go of her hands, bend down and rub them carefully.
After confirming that it was correct, my heart dropped and I took a long breath.
"I'm scared to death. If I can't repair it well, Eunuch Fan will definitely not let me go tomorrow!"
A broken table is not worth much money, and the palace compound is not short of rotten wood. The problem lies in the new deputy manager of the medicinal kitchen-Fan Dai and Eunuch Fan.
This person comes from the Superior Food Supervisor of the Medicinal Food Room. When he takes office as a new official, he can find faults in everything, let alone make real mistakes.
A few days ago, another palace maid, Xiaocui, was dragged into the sun by Eunuch Fan to discipline her just for spilling half a glass of water.
He was praised for his strict law and discipline, and he slapped him with every drop of water, and finally slapped him several times in the mouth.
Xiaocui's face has not swollen yet, and she has become the only injured person in the medicine room.
